F-0204 / F-0403: verify_graph on a healthy multigraph with two parallel edges reports missing adjacency.
    Oracle: spec 234 SC-005 (zero drift on a multigraph) and spec.md:78-80.

drift.detail: rows in Graph_KG.rdf_edges with no ^KG("out") entry, so traversal cannot see them
rows with no ^KG("in") entry, so inbound traversal cannot see them

oracle: verify_graph(g)['ok'] is true for a multigraph whose index matches its rows
